# v0.7.0b1 — Clearer settings and more reliable charging plans

Beta release of the integration and app. **0.6.1 remains the stable release.**

- **Clearer configuration:** five separate areas, with detail pages only for
  the features you select. Changes are saved per area.
- **Optional vehicle connections:** vehicle adapters are separated from
  charging logic. Manual departure times, calendars and ordinary HA sensors
  remain independent; existing BavarianData settings are retained.
- **Tariff fixes:** working Module 2/3 dialogs, an explicit Home-based import
  choice, reliable annual refresh and support for previously saved schedules.
- **Charging reliability:** reached targets block delayed start commands;
  changed vehicle data replaces obsolete plans. Departure planning handles
  unknown vehicle phases and equivalent timestamps correctly. Disabling it
  clears old trips, and loss estimates recover after temporary storage errors.

Keep your existing HA entry and app data. For all shared control fixes, update
the app to **0.7.0b1** from **#apps-beta**, then the integration. **#apps** stays on
stable 0.6.1; service compatibility remains API 2 and version 0.6.1 or newer.
Direct USB/LAN needs no app. Enable beta versions in HACS to install this preview.
